title: About
text:
A psychologist, music therapist, and songwriter originally from Heraklion, Crete, and now based in Thessaloniki, Giorgos Fanourakis connects art with the soul, composing music for the things language struggles to express.

Having written the music and lyrics for the single "Ninemia" (2025), and following the release of his debut album "Archetypa" (2023), he featured on Dimitris Tompazis's album "Chromatoneira" with the song "Rodakino". He is now preparing for the release of the LP "Aneu SynOdeias" (2026), in which he sets to music and performs the poetry collection of the same name by Nikiforos Blemenos.

In his live performances—both on stage and busking on the street—he shares released tracks alongside unreleased material waiting for its turn to see the light of day.

*I invite you to put on your headphones and truly experience it. I would be delighted if you shared your feelings with me.*
